    CoSE Student Success & Events Coordinator (Administrative Analyst/Specialist - Exempt I, Range II) - College of Science & Engineering San Francisco October 07, 2026
    The College of Science & Engineering is currently recruiting for an engaging and organized Events Coordinator and Student success individual to plan student events for the college, such as Student Showcase, the CoSE Career Fair, and working with regional industry companies.
    Clinical and Practicum Coordinator - (Student Services Professional III, Range 1) - Department of Speech, Language & Hearing Sciences San Francisco October 07, 2026
    The Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences Department Clinical and Practicum Coordinator is a full-time staff position who will serve as the main point of contact for arranging on and off-campus placements for graduate and undergraduate practica each semester. This position is essential to the day-to-day operations of SLHS and to the timely academic and professional progression of approximately 80–85 graduate students each year.
    Lead Housing Operations Specialist- (Housing Operations Professional III, Range 1) - HDCS Housing, Dining and Conference Services San Francisco October 02, 2026
    The Lead Housing Operations Specialist independently administers and coordinates complex housing operations and residential licensing programs for Employee & Family Housing. The position serves as the operational lead for the Employee & Family Housing licensing function, providing advanced program administration, operational leadership, strategic planning, and lead work direction to support housing operations, occupancy management, resident services, regulatory compliance, and continuous process improvement.
    Senior Director of Cloud Applications (Administrator III, Range 1) - San Francisco Bay Region Network, Information Technology Services San Francisco October 02, 2026
    The Senior Director of Cloud Applications is a critical leadership position responsible for the stability, continued development, and long-term strategy of a broad portfolio of technology services supporting the SFBRN universities. The position oversees the universities’ primary digital communications channels, including web and mobile platforms, as well as non-ERP applications supporting document management, residence halls, enrollment management, advancement, academic programs, and other administrative and student-facing functions.
    Web and Digital Design Content Specialist ( Marketing Communications Professional II ) - Enrollment Management and Marketing San Francisco October 02, 2026
    We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Web and Digital Design Content Specialist to join our team. This individual will play a crucial role in curating visual content, ensuring brand consistency, enhancing user experience (UX) for our web presence, managing digital displays, and performing Drupal content management. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with our web team, our creative team, and our content team and be responsible for updating our events database, ensuring our digital communications are engaging, effective, and on-brand. Under general supervision of the Director of Brand and Marketing and in close collaboration with the Lead Digital Communications Specialist, the incumbent independently performs most day-to-day assignments related to web content, digital design, and website governance. The incumbent applies professional judgment in creating and maintaining digital content, ensuring compliance with accessibility and brand standards, analyzing website effectiveness, and recommending improvements based on analytics, SEO, UX, and digital marketing best practices. To be effective in this role, you must be proficient in graphic design, as well as the crafter of excellent end user content. The Web and Digital Design Content Specialist must have a strong eye for effective website design and a strong ear for well-written, SEO-driven content. The Web and Digital Design Content Specialist has a strong desire to continuously improve on what they’ve crafted. The Web and Digital Design Content Specialist is always looking for new opportunities and ways to repurpose, reuse, and recycle content. They also spend time looking at the traffic on a website, with a goal of improving end user experience. They must also learn to think like a marketing communications professional, which will help them create an impactful website that drives traffic to key targeted pages.
    Assistant Professor, College of Ethnic Studies San Francisco September 29, 2026
    San Francisco State University, College of Ethnic Studies offers an exciting opportunity for a tenure-track Assistant Professor position in one of the five departments including Africana Studies, American Indian Studies, Asian American Studies, Latina/o Studies and Race and Resistance Studies beginning August, 2027.
    ITS Service Desk Coordinator (Technology Support Specialist II, Range 1) - San Francisco Bay Region Network San Francisco September 28, 2026
    The Service Desk Specialist position is a critical part of the IT User Support Specialist team, which supports the day-to-day IT operations of all SFBRN staff and students.
    Network Engineer (Network and Communications Analyst IV, Range 1) - San Francisco Bay Region Network San Francisco September 28, 2026
    The Network Engineer leads highly complex network infrastructure initiatives and serves as a key technical advisor to management, technical teams, vendors, and campus stakeholders on enterprise network architecture, infrastructure modernization, service reliability, security, performance, and operational standards.
    Payroll Technician (Payroll Technician II, Range 1) - San Francisco Bay Region Network (Payroll Services) San Francisco September 28, 2026
    Reporting to and under close supervision from the Director of Payroll, the Payroll Technician performs experienced-level payroll processing and serves as a technical resource within the Payroll team of the San Francisco Bay Region Network (“SFBRN” or “The Network”). This position is responsible for the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll transactions, and provides guidance and support to Payroll Technicians processing payroll for California State University, East Bay (CSUEB), San Francisco State University (SFSU), and Sonoma State University (SSU).
    Travel & Expense Operation Lead (Accounts Payable Technician IV, Range 1) - San Francisco Bay Region Network San Francisco September 28, 2026
    This role supports daily Travel & Expense operations and ensures transactions are accurate, timely, and compliant with policies and procedures. It serves as a T&E expert, helping resolve complex issues and providing guidance to staff and campus partners. The role also supports audits, reporting, system improvements, and process changes to improve efficiency and consistency across the Network.
    College Corps Coordinator (Administrative Analyst/Specialist, Exempt I) - Office of Research and Sponsored Programs/Institute for Civic and Community Engagement San Francisco September 24, 2026
    Under the general direction of the Executive Director, the College Corps Coordinator is responsible for coordinating the day-to-day implementation and administration of the California College Corps program within the Institute for Civic & Community Engagement (ICCE) at San Francisco State University. The Coordinator supports all aspects of program administration, including participant recruitment and engagement, community partnership development, grant compliance, fiscal administration and financial tracking, communications, events, assessment, and program evaluation to ensure the successful implementation of a complex state and federally funded initiative.
    Dean’s Office Executive Coordinator - (Executive Assistant III, Range I) - CPaGE Administration San Francisco September 24, 2026
    The Executive Assistant III Coordinator will provide consistent high-level support to the Dean and Associate Dean and ensure effective and confidential coordination of Dean’s Office operations, strategic initiatives, and college-wide administrative processes. The position will provide needed capacity to manage executive priorities, annual planning processes, communications, projects, and operational needs across CPaGE locations.
    Content Marketing Specialist - (Marketing Communications Professional II, Range I) - CPaGE Administration San Francisco September 24, 2026
    This position reports to the Director of Marketing and Communications. Primary responsibilities include content writing and editing for print and digital media (including email campaigns, social media, flyers and brochures) in collaboration with the college’s various programs and departments. The Content Marketing Specialist will merge marketing, communications and project management skills with the goal of increasing CPaGE enrollments. They will coordinate with the CPaGE Marketing team and program stakeholders to provide excellent prospective student user experience and maximum engagement. The specialist will be expected to liaise with appropriate University departments and other marketing staff to ensure proper and consistent branding and accessibility protocols are followed.
    Director of Housing Facilities - (Administrator II) - Housing, Dining and Conference Services San Francisco September 23, 2026
    The Director for Housing Facilities provides leadership, strategy, and oversight for the delivery of services to fulfill the department's goals, objectives, and policies set by the Associate Vice President of Housing, Dining & Conference Services. The Director achieves these objectives through the coordinated accomplishments of the assigned staff to ensure its complex daily responsibilities for maintenance, custodial/housekeeping, facilities operations, and projects is delivered. The department achieves its goals through the practice of sound financial management and business principles. The department values continuous improvement to achieve maximum efficiencies to support the enrollment target of the University. The Director for Housing Facilities is responsible for establishing a culture of collaboration and partnership while representing the unique needs of Housing Services.
    Budget & Scheduler Coordinator - (Administrative Analyst/Specialist Exempt I, Range II) - Campus Rec/Student Engagement San Francisco September 23, 2026
    Under the general supervision of the Assistant Dean of Student engagement, the Facility & Scheduling Coordinator will serve in the new, state of the art, 118,700 square-foot Mashouf Wellness Center (MWC) that opened in 2017. The incumbent coordinates operations and scheduling for event and recreation spaces. within Division of Student life. The smooth operation and general supervision of the Mashouf Wellness Center (MWC), ANNEX and all Recreational indoor & outdoor spaces. Additionally, the incumbent is coordinates and monitors budget activity. for engagement unit & serve reservations and scheduling approver. As well as events set-up for spaces through the student engagement Unit under the Division of Student Life. Lastly, the incumbent is responsible to coordinate and process accounts payable, procurement purchases, and purchase orders. and serve as the liaison between the student engagement Unit in the procurement office. Incumbent must strategically align work and outcomes in a way that supports the mission of the SF State campus, Student Affairs cabinet area, the Student Life, and Campus Recreation/Mashouf Wellness Center, and is in line with NIRSA: Leaders in Collegiate Recreation, and other higher education and industry best practices
    Outdoor & Leadership Coordinator - (Administrative Analyst/Specialist Exempt I, Range II) - Campus Recreation San Francisco September 23, 2026
    Come and join the Campus Recreation team at SF State. We have a thriving department focused on student engagaement and recretional leadership.
    Campus Planner and Project Manager - (Administrator II) - Capital Project Management San Francisco September 23, 2026
    Reporting to the Associate Vice President for Capital Planning, Design, and Construction and Facilities Services (AVP), the Campus Planner/Project Manager is a hybrid position within Capital Planning, Design, and Construction, and is an individual contributor as well as key member of the senior leadership team. The incumbent collaborates on campus activities related to the planning and design of capital projects, encompassing buildings and grounds, and represents campus interests on planning capital projects to see that the university’s needs are met. The incumbent leads planning, programming, and preliminary studies that substantiate campus requests for capital funding and sets project parameters prior to schematic design. The incumbent furthers the campus master plan development and implementation, capital outlay planning, feasibility studies, and space management. This position includes preparing the required CPDC reporting to the Chancellor’s Office annually and biannually. The Campus Planner/Project Manager may manage some staff and resources related to campus planning/project management including professional and/or student staff, and an overall project tracking system for the department.
    Director, Facilities Operations - (Administrator III) - Facilities Operations San Francisco September 23, 2026
    Under the general direction of the Associate Vice President (AVP) of Capital Planning, Design and Construction (CPDC) and Facilities Services (FS), the Director of Facilities Operations is responsible for the strategic planning, operation, and maintenance of facilities and utility systems at SF State’s main campus, including maintenance programs for academic and support facilities and the Central Utility Plant. The incumbent also provides supervisory oversight of the Director of Facilities Operations at the Estuary and Ocean Science Center, while responsibility for the site’s daily facilities operations remains with that director. The incumbent supports the mission of SF State, the Administration and Finance cabinet area, and Facilities Services.
    Lead Engineer - (Supervising Building Service Engineer) - Facilities Services – Mechanical Maintenance San Francisco September 23, 2026
    Under the general direction of the Director, Facilities Operations, the Lead Engineer is primarily responsible for providing lead direction and working with one or more groups or crews of skilled and semi-skilled workers involved in the installation, operation, maintenance, and repair of mechanical systems including heating, ventilation, refrigeration, air conditioning, swimming pools, library retrieving system (LRS), and equipment throughout a campus.
    Nurse Clinic Manager - (Administrator II) - Student Health Services San Francisco September 23, 2026
    Under the leadership of the Director of the Student Health Services (SHS), the Nurse Clinic Manager is responsible for the care provided to SF State University students by SHS's Registered Nurses and licensed/unlicensed clinical support staff. The Nurse Clinic Manager is responsible for leading the daily and administrative functions in the SHS. Principal responsibilities include operations, managing of staff and resources, facilitating research and education, and maintaining compliance with policies, procedures, and regulations. The Nurse Clinic Manager establishes quality improvement efforts to support the delivery of patient focused care and knowledge-based decision making as the framework for superior delivery of care. The Nurse Clinic Manager facilitates communication, coordination, and collaboration among the SHS staff regarding identification, planning, and provision of high quality, cost-effective care. The Nurse Clinic Manager is a resource within the SHS and to the SFSU community. The Nurse Clinic Manager is a key member of the SHS Leadership Team. This is an on-site position.
